verdict.rationale: The product documents its own bulk upload process for equity promises (docs-4). Promises can then be converted into grants (docs-18), so this is first-party bulk input on the issuance path, but nothing shows bulk issuance of actual grants or import of historical transactions. Missing for 10: documented bulk import of grants or securities, bulk import of historical cap-table transactions, file format and validation details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
